after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.player: I stole the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.

after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.speaker: Rologarth
after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.text: I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide it. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.

after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.player: Do you want the ring back? It is yours after all.

after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.speaker: Rologarth
after-creature-of-fenkenstrain.text: No, you keep it, my friend. Werewolves hunger for the scent of live flesh - I have no need for the ring. I have my castle back, if not my soul.
